summary: Ballard Power Systems Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire GeoPura Limited for an upfront equity purchase price of £275.0 million (~US$400 million enterprise value), funded by £82.5 million cash and ~50.8 million Ballard common shares at US$5.02 per share (30-day VWAP), plus up to £27.5 million contingent consideration. The transaction establishes Ballard as an integrated hydrogen ecosystem provider with an energy-as-a-service model. No board recommendation or advisors named. Expected to close with synergies of US$25 million annual run-rate EBITDA. Watch for regulatory clearance and milestone achievement for contingent consideration.
